t: Ceremony to present the banner of the Federal Customs Service
d: A ceremony to present the banner of the Federal Customs Service took place in the Kremlin’s St Catherine Hall. FCS Head Valery Pikalev received the banner from the President.
The President received Mayor of Vladivostok Konstantin Shestakov in the Kremlin and proposed that he take up the post of Acting Governor of the Primorye Territory.

t: Konstantin Shestakov appointed Acting Governor of Primorye Territory
d: Vladimir Putin signed Executive Order On Acting Governor of the Primorye Territory .

t: Gala evening of the Russian Union of Theatre Workers
d: The President attended the gala evening dedicated to the 10th Congress and 150th anniversary of the Russian Union of Theatre Workers. The organisation restored its original name by rebranding itself as the Russian Theatrical Society.
